name: Why does Denver-area soil and climate matter during floor tile installation?

mainEntity.name: Why does Denver-area soil and climate matter during floor tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners across the Denver metro area, including communities like Aurora, Parker, and Centennial, face shifting soils and dry indoor winters that cause subfloors to expand and contract. Because clay-rich soils in Front Range neighborhoods can cause minor home movement, using an uncoupling membrane between the subfloor and the tile is essential. This membrane absorbs subtle floor movement, preventing seasonal foundation shifts from cracking your grout lines or breaking floor tiles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver-area expansive soils and climate shifts cause home movement; using an uncoupling membrane isolates the tile from subfloor stress to prevent cracked tiles.
